impact: About 25 failures are SQLSTATE undefined-column errors naming host, error and progress on TaskRunner tables, plus a not-null violation and a string-truncation. The tests write columns the current migrations do not define. Needs a decision per column: restore it, or update the tests to the schema that shipped.
resolution: Answered and partly fixed. The schema is right and the tests are wrong - no columns were lost. 'error' and 'progress' are ACCESSORS on Task reading from the options JSON column (getErrorAttribute/getProgressAttribute), never columns and never in $fillable; TaskShowCommandTest wrote them as top-level attributes. Fixed by folding them into 'options' across 8 create() calls. The 'host'/'group' failures are a different table entirely (servers, not task_runner_tasks) and a different cause - split to ISS-016. The residue of TaskShowCommandTest is assertion-style drift, split to ISS-015.
title: TaskRunner tests assert against a schema the migrations no longer have
